description: The shipment's current public read-only tracking link (a URL anyone can open without logging in), if it has one. Use it before sending a link; use create_share_link when there is none. `shipment` (required) is the BerthTime id, the tracked reference, or a container number on the shipment. Returns: shipment_id, share_link {url, active, expires_at, view_count, ...} or null. Needs write access: a read + write API key, or read + write access granted at sign-in by an owner or admin of the company.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

shipment.description: BerthTime shipment id, or the tracked reference (container, bill of lading or booking number), or a container number on the shipment.

name: get_share_link
title: Get share link
